notes.text: Add removal reminders for Compulsions alongside the existing removal reminders for Conditions. Compulsions should be scheduled for removal at the end of the session _after_ they were applied (i.e. at the end of the next _full_ session).

Fully retire the "hold hotkey over NPC token to spotlight them" feature.

- Fully remove the generation of and spawning of NPC tokens into the game world for the purpose of spotlighting. NPC tokens no longer have a use and should be removed entirely.
- Remove the hotkey-triggered spotlighting mechanic itself
- If NPCs have spotlight objects solely used for the spotlight effect, remove them as well (if the spotlight effect uses their normal NPC light, ignore this)
